archimate:Outcome.name: Improved Care Coordination, Reduced Duplication
archimate:Outcome.documentation:
The "Improved Care Coordination, Reduced Duplication" goal is a patient-centric operational milestone focused on aligning multidisciplinary providers and seamlessly sharing clinical data to eliminate redundant medical tests, procedures, and administrative efforts.
Its purpose is to optimize healthcare resource utilization and enhance the patient experience by ensuring that care delivery is highly synchronized and free of wasteful, costly overlaps.
Example: A health network achieves this goal by allowing an orthopedic specialist to instantly view an MRI scan taken at a primary care clinic the previous day, preventing the patient from undergoing and paying for an unnecessary second scan.
